costs.base: observed bid/ask plus 0.10 pip slippage per side
costs.stress: observed bid/ask plus 0.25 pip slippage per side

preregistration.economic_rationale: Synchronized currency returns may reveal relative information diffusion across the currency graph, a cross-sectional mechanism distinct from the eight rejected single-pair indicator families.
preregistration.embargo: maximum lookback plus maximum holding period at every chronological boundary
preregistration.falsifiable_hypothesis: After bid/ask costs, next-bar trades pairing the strongest currency with the weakest have positive validation expectancy and meet every frozen gate; otherwise reject the family.

features.lookahead_rule: signal uses only bars complete before next tradable bid/ask entry
features.returns: completed synchronized mid-close log returns with base positive and quote negative signs
features.strength: equal-weight signed underlying-currency return over lookback

preregistration.final_holdout_opening_rule: only one code-and-rules-frozen pre-holdout champion may be evaluated once under a separately authorized packet
preregistration.rejection_rule: reject the complete family when no preregistered candidate passes every gate; do not filter failed results by pair or session

rules.currency_exposure_cap: one net unit-risk per underlying currency; block duplicate exposure
rules.entry: next eligible bid/ask open for an available strongest-versus-weakest pair
rules.exit: first stop, target, or time exit; evaluated on executable bid/ask
rules.financing: zero only for intraday positions closed before financing boundary; otherwise reject implementation
rules.position_sizing: 0.25 percent risk per trade, volatility normalized
rules.session: all sessions except preregistered rollover exclusion 21:55-22:10 UTC

preregistration.walk_forward: six anchored development folds; train-only construction followed by next-fold scoring
